title: Infrastructure-as-code policy guardrail
summary: Pre-deployment policy-as-code guardrail (Open Policy Agent / Checkov / Conftest / provider-native equivalent) that evaluates IaC changes against the operator's posture policy before they reach the control plane. Pairs with the CSPM baseline: the guardrail prevents deviations from landing, the CSPM baseline catches what slipped through.

component.title: IaC policy guardrail
component.description: Pre-merge / pre-apply policy enforcement on infrastructure-as-code changes.

control-implementations.description: Implements configuration management gating at change-introduction time.

implemented-requirements.description: Configuration change control: changes are reviewed against the configured baseline before approval.
Least functionality: guardrail blocks resource types and configurations not on the allow-list.

sources: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 — CM-3 Configuration Change Control, CM-7 Least Functionality
